title: Specify duration explicitly (e.g., 15.00 seconds) to force a single continuous…
content:
Specify duration explicitly (e.g., 15.00 seconds) to force a single continuous clip length in Seedance 2.5  
Set FORMAT to 9:16 vertical to generate a portrait video output  
Prompt for ONE uninterrupted first-person helmet-mounted POV from the FIRST rider to lock the camera perspective to a continuous rider POV shot  
Enable Native synchronized audio ON to generate video with synced audio  
Add photorealistic live-action and authentic accidental to steer Seedance toward realistic footage with imperfect, candid motion/feel
tips:
Specify duration explicitly (e.g., 15.00 seconds) to force a single continuous clip length in Seedance 2.5  
Set FORMAT to 9:16 vertical to generate a portrait video output  
Prompt for ONE uninterrupted first-person helmet-mounted POV from the FIRST rider to lock the camera perspective to a continuous rider POV shot  
Enable Native synchronized audio ON to generate video with synced audio  
Add photorealistic live-action and authentic accidental to steer Seedance toward realistic footage with imperfect, candid motion/feel

es.content:
Especifica la duración explícitamente (por ejemplo, 15.00 segundos) para forzar una única duración continua del clip en Seedance 2.5  
Configura FORMAT en 9:16 vertical para generar una salida de video en formato retrato  
Pide un POV en primera persona, continuo e ininterrumpido, montado en el casco, desde el PRIMER rider, para fijar la perspectiva de la cámara a una toma continua en POV del rider  
Activa Native synchronized audio en ON para generar video con audio sincronizado  
Añade photorealistic live-action y authentic accidental para orientar Seedance hacia metraje realista con movimiento/sensación imperfectos y espontáneos

fr.content:
Spécifiez explicitement la durée (par exemple, 15,00 secondes) pour imposer une longueur de clip unique et continue dans Seedance 2.5  
Définissez FORMAT sur 9:16 vertical pour générer une vidéo au format portrait  
Demandez un POV à la première personne, monté sur casque, UNIQUE et ininterrompu, depuis le PREMIER rider, afin de verrouiller la perspective de la caméra sur un plan POV continu du rider  
Activez Native synchronized audio sur ON pour générer une vidéo avec audio synchronisé  
Ajoutez photorealistic live-action et authentic accidental pour orienter Seedance vers des images réalistes avec un mouvement et une sensation imparfaits et spontanés

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 で単一の連続したクリップ長を強制するには、duration を明示的に指定します（例: 15.00 seconds）  
縦長のポートレート動画を生成するには、FORMAT を 9:16 vertical に設定します  
カメラ視点を連続した rider POV ショットに固定するには、FIRST rider からの ONE uninterrupted first-person helmet-mounted POV を prompt します  
同期音声付きの動画を生成するには、Native synchronized audio を ON にします  
Seedance を、完璧ではない自然な動きや雰囲気を持つリアルな映像へ誘導するには、photorealistic live-action と authentic accidental を追加します

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5에서 단일 연속 클립 길이를 강제하려면 지속 시간을 명시적으로 지정하세요(예: 15.00초)  
세로형 영상 출력을 생성하려면 FORMAT을 9:16 세로로 설정하세요  
카메라 시점을 연속적인 라이더 POV 샷으로 고정하려면 FIRST rider의 ONE uninterrupted first-person helmet-mounted POV를 요청하세요  
동기화된 오디오가 포함된 비디오를 생성하려면 Native synchronized audio를 ON으로 설정하세요  
Seedance가 불완전하고 자연스러운 움직임/느낌이 있는 현실적인 영상으로 유도되도록 photorealistic live-action과 authentic accidental을 추가하세요

pt.content:
Especifique a duração explicitamente (por exemplo, 15.00 segundos) para forçar um único clipe contínuo no Seedance 2.5  
Defina FORMAT como 9:16 vertical para gerar uma saída de vídeo em formato retrato  
Use um prompt para UM POV em primeira pessoa, contínuo e sem interrupções, com câmera montada no capacete do PRIMEIRO piloto, para travar a perspectiva da câmera em uma tomada contínua em POV do piloto  
Ative Native synchronized audio em ON para gerar vídeo com áudio sincronizado  
Adicione photorealistic live-action e authentic accidental para orientar o Seedance em direção a imagens realistas, com movimento/sensação imperfeitos e espontâneos

zh.content:
明确指定时长（例如 15.00 seconds），以强制 Seedance 2.5 生成单个连续片段长度  
将 FORMAT 设置为 9:16 vertical，以生成竖屏视频输出  
提示为来自第一位骑手的 ONE uninterrupted first-person helmet-mounted POV，以将相机视角锁定为连续的骑手第一人称 POV 镜头  
启用 Native synchronized audio ON，以生成带同步音频的视频  
添加 photorealistic live-action 和 authentic accidental，以引导 Seedance 生成更真实的画面，呈现不完美、自然随性的运动/质感
